summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, providing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 9, 2026. The meeting will cover standard items: receiving audited financial statements, fixing the number of directors at five, electing directors, reappointing the auditor, and transacting other business. The record date is April 21, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine annual meeting notification.
